name: Verify File Existence Before Read
description: Always check if a file exists on local disk using os.path.exists before attempting to read or parse its contents.

name: Format Judicial Circuit Header
description: When rendering court or formal administrative documents, format the header with explicit Judicial Circuit number, County name, and Case Number.

name: Extract Milestone Deadlines to Checklist
description: When reviewing incoming intake documents, extract all explicitly mentioned hearing or response deadlines and append them to CLIENT_FILE.md.
